test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which of the following Funds has the scheme 'One Stop Centre (OSC) scheme' been implemented across the country since 1 April 2015 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirbhaya Fund.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **One Stop Centre** (OSC) scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** in **2015** to provide support and assistance to women affected by violence.
 
• Facilitating access to a wide range of assistance for women affected by **abuse** is the scheme's main goal. 
 
• The **Nirbhaya Fund** was set up in **2013** in the aftermath of the** Delhi gang-rape case** to support initiatives aimed at enhancing the safety and security of women in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **PM National Relief Fund** is a fund set up to provide assistance to people affected by **natural calamities **and other emergencies.
 
• **Durga Vahini Fund** is a fund set up by the** Vishwa Hindu Parishad **to support initiatives aimed at promoting Hindu culture and values.
 
• **Women Empowerment Fund** is a general term and could refer to any fund set up to support initiatives aimed at empowering women.
